findings.title: Control Plane authorization mismatch
findings.detail: requireAuth only; no role check. Any authenticated user can toggle kill switch, edit policies.

findings.title: Google redirect URI default mismatch
findings.detail: Default localhost:4000 contradicts .env.example localhost:5173. Silent cookie failure in local dev.

findings.title: No PKCE in Google OAuth
findings.detail: No code_verifier/code_challenge. Google recommends PKCE for all OAuth clients.

findings.title: No OIDC nonce parameter
findings.detail: authorizeUrl() does not include nonce parameter for replay protection.

findings.title: Coworkers frontend contract drift
findings.detail: Backend returns snake_case (coworker_type, task_id), frontend expects camelCase. Runs always empty (no projectId query).

findings.title: Hardcoded OpenAI health status
findings.detail: openai: { status: 'ok' } hardcoded instead of checking real provider health.

findings.title: Missing skip-to-content link
findings.detail: WCAG 2.4.1 violation. cc-sr-only class exists in global.css.

findings.title: Free usage 'daily' wording vs rolling window
findings.detail: SSE messages say 'daily limit' but system is 24h rolling window. Cosmetic.

findings.title: SESSION_COOKIE_SECURE defaults to false
findings.detail: Production guard enforces true, but staging without NODE_ENV=production could use HTTP cookies.
